trigger: 256-parent original flexible additive-word raw pilot had negative held-apart gain for every seed. Purely diagnostic, not a replacement of the original ladder or an authorization to tune on audit.
diagnostic: Use every site of the same oriented 4^3 input and same microscopic target, still emitting only four hard outputs. Estimate a linear predictor of all four target sites' species-indicator contrasts from centered species indicators at all 64 input sites (intercept and ridge). Pool the exact in-plane D4 rotation/reflection equivariances in training via permutation of fit sufficient statistics; no x-axis reversal, no held-parent pooling. Initialize four hard centroids in the predictive subspace and alternate Lloyd quantization. This restricts supervision to 8 face first-moment contrasts rather than chasing 81 full-face classes in sparse 3^8 word bins. Fit the identical 81-class half-count decoder and frozen marginal on all fit faces. 1000 anchors/parent. Evaluate 256/1024/4096 and all three paired seeds after 1,2,4,8 iterations; final = 8, no best-of selection. Report primary raw as well as diagnostic. No audit tuning. If lower bound above zero, the diagnostic establishes an available physical-face signal, not success of the original flexible readout.
predictor: Ridge 0.01 times mean predictor diagonal; intercept centered by fit means; 2 indicators per input/target site (vacant and species 1, last species implicit). Lloyd uses Euclidean distance on component-wise standardized predicted target probabilities (scale by fit Bernoulli standard deviation); initialize by quadrant centroids in seed-rotated top 2 PCs. Stop after 8 irrespective of results.
